title: Kenworth K200 FUPS Polished High Tensile Aluminium Road Train Bullbar #68
description: Kenworth K200 high tensile polished aluminium FUPS compliant Road Train Bullbar, Extended main channel and extended main uprights to lower high tensile aluminium RHS Box Cow Catcher cross member with vents to cool oil cooler & spotlight mounts allow maximum clearance from back of light to cab. Centre mounted cow catchers protect EBSS safety system .76mm pipes std. option of 88mm or 100 pipe. Main pipes are one piece passing through drilled heavy duty uprights. Heavy duty tow pin in steel backing plate. Flip over aluminium Road Train signs plus a Dangerous Goods sign on aluminium backing plate. A lift assist spring is fitted to aid easy access for cab tilt.
